title: Be Occt Brep Kernel Bridge
scope: Adapter OCCT, BRep, NURBS evaluation, tolerances, memory ownership/FFI safety.

staged_stl_shared_admission_2026_11_05.scope: Replace whole-headroom captured/Controller and detached STL leases with shared phase admission; add Rust native-source/snapshot copy hooks, preserve typed refusal and selection allocation phases
staged_stl_shared_admission_2026_11_05.limitations: Native conversion/meshing allocations precede copy callbacks and are not bounded by this admission. Topology/hash scratch stays estimated pending; full allocator/path/worker/receipt ownership, automatic eviction, UI background integration, release/desktop and the rest of P1-P5 remain open.

stl_export_no_display_edge_sampling_2026.scope: Omit viewport-only sampled edge polylines from export snapshots with topology bindings
stl_export_no_display_edge_sampling_2026.limitations: No release A/B memory peak or comprehensive geometry equivalence; other native allocations remain unbounded

multiedge_curved_loft_memory_2026_11_04.scope: Measure process high-water for 12-edge fillet and curved 32-section loft, with volume and closedness checks
multiedge_curved_loft_memory_2026_11_04.limitations: Synthetic process samples, not native allocation bounds; complex real models, native OOM and concurrent jobs remain open

stl_fan_adjacency_admission_2026_11_04.scope: Check known indexed fan adjacency and traversal capacities alongside retained fan lists
stl_fan_adjacency_admission_2026_11_04.limitations: Hash metadata, allocator, native and encoded-output allocations remain outside the lower bound

stl_vertex_fan_list_admission_2026_11_04.scope: Known fan-table and per-vertex link capacities are checked during indexed STL topology analysis; adjacency and encoded-output scratch remain open.

stl_edge_stage_admission_2026_11_04.scope: Check known indexed face and edge table capacities at growth boundaries
stl_edge_stage_admission_2026_11_04.limitations: Hash metadata, allocator peaks, fan and encoded-output stages remain outside this lower bound

stl_indexed_topology_minimum_2026_11_04.scope: Admit retained STL soup and minimum topology union-find arrays together
stl_indexed_topology_minimum_2026_11_04.limitations: Hash maps, fan scratch and encoded-output analysis remain outside the lower bound

stl_brep_amortized_growth_2026_11_04.scope: Plan B-rep output growth with amortized capacity and combined exact fallback
stl_brep_amortized_growth_2026_11_04.limitations: Allocator, topology and native transient peaks remain incomplete

stl_authored_mesh_growth_admission_2026_.scope: Preflight authored STL mesh buffer growth with amortized capacity and exact-size fallback
stl_authored_mesh_growth_admission_2026_.limitations: Allocator, topology diagnostics and native transient peaks remain incomplete

stl_brep_output_growth_admission_2026_11.scope: Preflight old and new STL B-rep output buffers with source and remap retained
stl_brep_output_growth_admission_2026_11.limitations: Authored-mesh growth, allocator and native transient peaks remain incomplete

stl_topology_lookup_estimate_2026_11_04.scope: Include conservative remap lookup-tree estimates in STL admission
stl_topology_lookup_estimate_2026_11_04.limitations: Allocator, output growth and native transient peaks remain incomplete

stl_topology_remap_minimum_2026_11_04.scope: Admit snapshot and minimum remap arrays together in STL
stl_topology_remap_minimum_2026_11_04.limitations: Lookup maps, output growth and native/allocator transients are not bounded

stl_soup_snapshot_admission_2026_11_04.scope: Deduct existing STL soup and temporary source capacities before native snapshot admission
stl_soup_snapshot_admission_2026_11_04.limitations: Native, remap and output-growth peaks remain outside complete admission

stl_worker_snapshot_reservation_cap_2026.scope: Cap experimental STL worker snapshot admission at its reservation
stl_worker_snapshot_reservation_cap_2026.limitations: Does not bound native mesher transients or concurrent export scratch

grouped_topology_copy_admission_2026_11_.scope: Admit retained Rust snapshot and grouped topology arrays in one synchronous callback account
grouped_topology_copy_admission_2026_11_.limitations: Native, allocator and validation peaks remain outside this account

occt_snapshot_copy_preflight_2026_11_04.scope: Check aggregate minimum Rust snapshot buffer size before copying native snapshot arrays
occt_snapshot_copy_preflight_2026_11_04.limitations: Native buffers, grouped bindings, validation scratch and allocator peaks remain unaccounted

kernel_operation_memory_probe_2026_11_04.scope: Measure isolated process high-water for simple Boolean, Fillet and Loft fixtures
kernel_operation_memory_probe_2026_11_04.limitations: Synthetic process-wide high-water is not a native upper bound or admission envelope

nurbs_ray_miss_2026_11_03.scope: Distinguish a completed NURBS ray miss from invalid inputs and native failure while preserving legacy error-on-miss callers.
nurbs_ray_miss_2026_11_03.limitations: Synthetic candidate; general ambiguous intersections, native memory and desktop evidence remain open.

fixed_face_ray_output_2026_11_03.scope: Expose bounded inline face-ray results while retaining the existing vector wrapper; UI and experimental worker avoid point/group-result heap vectors.
fixed_face_ray_output_2026_11_03.limitations: Other Rust allocations and OCCT native peak remain outside a complete admission bound; desktop remains unverified.

bounded_face_ray_groups_2026_11_03.scope: Bounded synchronous OCCT adapter reconstructs a call-local B-rep once for up to eight ordered face-ray intersections; Rust owns identities, output and worker lifecycle.
bounded_face_ray_groups_2026_11_03.limitations: Worker and synchronous UI use; no global native allocation bound, desktop acceptance or complete topology coverage.

sdk_integration_plan.scope_rule: All SDK-eligible child L3 are delivered with their public adapter; host-internal/governance work records an explicit reason instead of exposing private state.

baseline.qualification: Planning baseline only; source presence and runtime metadata are not new execution evidence.

sdk_integration_plan.owner_specific_task: Bọc selected BRep service, audit linked operations; từ chối fixture probes; Mac theo portability và packaging theo target.
tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.
